WITH base AS (
    SELECT
        i.i_category,
        i.i_class,
        i.i_brand,
        i.i_product_name,
        dd.d_year,
        dd.d_qoy,
        dd.d_moy,
        st.s_store_id,
        COALESCE(ss.ss_sales_price * ss.ss_quantity, 0) AS sales_amount
    FROM date_dim dd
    JOIN store_sales ss ON ss.ss_sold_date_sk = dd.d_date_sk
    JOIN store st ON ss.ss_store_sk = st.s_store_sk
    JOIN item i ON ss.ss_item_sk = i.i_item_sk
    WHERE dd.d_month_seq BETWEEN 1217 AND 1217 + 11
      AND st.s_store_id IS NOT NULL
),
grouped AS (
    SELECT
        base.i_category,
        base.i_class,
        base.i_brand,
        base.i_product_name,
        base.d_year,
        base.d_qoy,
        base.d_moy,
        base.s_store_id,
        SUM(base.sales_amount) AS sumsales
    FROM base
    GROUP BY
        base.i_category,
        base.i_class,
        base.i_brand,
        base.i_product_name,
        base.d_year,
        base.d_qoy,
        base.d_moy,
        base.s_store_id
    WITH ROLLUP
),
ranked AS (
    SELECT
        grouped.i_category,
        grouped.i_class,
        grouped.i_brand,
        grouped.i_product_name,
        grouped.d_year,
        grouped.d_qoy,
        grouped.d_moy,
        grouped.s_store_id,
        grouped.sumsales,
        RANK() OVER (PARTITION BY grouped.i_category ORDER BY grouped.sumsales DESC) AS rk
    FROM grouped
)
SELECT
    ranked.i_category,
    ranked.i_class,
    ranked.i_brand,
    ranked.i_product_name,
    ranked.d_year,
    ranked.d_qoy,
    ranked.d_moy,
    ranked.s_store_id,
    ranked.sumsales,
    ranked.rk
FROM ranked
WHERE ranked.rk <= 100
ORDER BY
    ranked.i_category,
    ranked.i_class,
    ranked.i_brand,
    ranked.i_product_name,
    ranked.d_year,
    ranked.d_qoy,
    ranked.d_moy,
    ranked.s_store_id,
    ranked.sumsales,
    ranked.rk
LIMIT 100
